verdict: GBP engagement has gone dark; paid channels need to be back online.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all lead-generating activity ran through your Google Business Profile — there was zero paid spend on Meta or Google Ads. Your GBP produced 53 total actions over the full period, but that activity has come to a near-complete stop: the profile recorded zero actions on each of the last four consecutive days (August 16–19), a pattern that signals a real drop in profile visibility, not routine fluctuation. Website sessions also dipped 11.76% week over week, though the last three days show a slight uptick, suggesting site traffic has not yet fully reflected the GBP slowdown. We're investigating the profile visibility issue now and moving to restore paid coverage so your lead flow is not dependent on a single organic channel.
